title: Exact Finite-Field Overbeck Frobenius-Shift Distinguishers, Skew-Polynomial Norm Identities, and Structure-Recovery Certificates for Linearized Reed-Solomon Codes
abstract: Motivated by the recent polynomial-time full structure recovery attack on Linearized Reed-Solomon (LRS) codes from an arbitrary generator matrix by Astore, Borello, and Couvreur (arXiv:2611.34835v1, Nov. 2026), we construct a machine-checked, zero-float finite-field verification and algebraic cryptanalysis suite (LRS-STRUCT-RECOV-CERT-1.0) backed by 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, -DwarningAsError=true), an AST-audited pure-integer F_{p^m} engine with Rabin irreducibility checks, 16 SHA-256 certificates (C01-C16), and 93 adversarial tests across GF(2^6), GF(3^5), GF(3^6), GF(5^4), and GF(5^5). We prove and certify: (i) the universal skew-norm cocycle N_{i+j}(a)=N_i(a)*sigma^i(N_j(a)) and Frobenius shift identity a*sigma(N_i(a))=N_{i+1}(a); (ii) the exact closed-form Overbeck-LRS bound dim Lambda_t(C) <= min(n, ell*k + ell*(t - ell + 1)) and exact defect factorization Delta_LRS(ell,k,t) = (t + 1 - ell)*(k - ell) for t >= ell, k >= ell, proving onset at t = ell whenever k > ell and ell*(k+1) < n; (iii) exact invariance of Frobenius-shift rank profiles under public-key scrambling G_pub = S*G_LRS*P; and (iv) shortening-induced block collapse dim Lambda_1(C_sh) <= k' + 1 + delta < 2k' whenever delta + 1 < k', triggering single-step distinguishers for high-rate 2-block and 3-block LRS codes.
